summary: Iteration 23 - Splynx Integration and Tickets Page Revamp Testing Complete. All 17 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend UI features verified: Tickets Page revamp with Service Desk header, stats cards, priority color-coded borders, SLA BREACH and AWAITING RESPONSE badges, filters, ticket detail view. Splynx tab on Client page with linking functionality. Settings page with Splynx ISP Billing configuration card.

critical_code_review_comments: Tickets Page revamp successfully shows 'Service Desk' header with ticket counts
Stats cards (Open, In Progress, Resolved, Critical, No Response, Avg Time) are clickable and filter correctly
Ticket cards have priority color-coded left borders (red=critical, orange=high, yellow=medium, green=low)
SLA BREACH and AWAITING RESPONSE badges display correctly on tickets
Search, Status filter, and Priority filter work correctly with Clear Filters button
Clicking a ticket opens the detail view with all tabs (Notes, Emails, Children, Time, Audit)
Splynx tab visible in Client page tabs list with Customer ID input and Link button
'No Splynx customer linked' message displays when not linked
Settings page shows Splynx ISP Billing card with URL, API Key, API Secret fields
Save Splynx Settings button and Test Connection button (when configured) are present
Email Security link visible in sidebar under Infrastructure section
All Splynx backend APIs properly mask credentials when returning settings
seed_data_creation: Used existing test data: 17 tickets (10 open, 5 in progress, 2 resolved, 4 critical, 15 with no notes), 6 clients
context_for_next_testing_agent: Splynx integration is fully implemented for settings CRUD and client linking. Since no real Splynx instance is connected, service/invoice fetching returns error messages which is expected. The Tickets Page revamp is complete with stats cards, priority borders, SLA badges, and filtering. All data-testid attributes are in place for automated testing.
